author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
In today’s countryside cooking video, we’re preparing **slow grilled chicken on a traditional saj pan** over an open fire. 🔥🍗 The gentle heat and simple cooking method create incredibly juicy chicken with a beautifully golden, slightly crispy skin. Watching it slowly cook on the hot saj brings out the rich aroma of wood fire and homemade comfort.

This dish is all about patience and natural flavor. The chicken is slowly grilled so it stays tender inside while developing a deep, smoky taste on the outside. Cooked on a saj pan, it gets that rustic countryside character that makes every bite satisfying.

The slow grilling process over fire gives the chicken a unique flavor you can’t get from regular cooking. Simple ingredients, calm outdoor cooking, and the warmth of village life make this meal truly special. 🍃🔥

#sajcooking #grilledchicken #villagecooking #outdoorcooking #countryfood
title: Slow Grilled Chicken on a Saj Pan – Cozy Countryside Cooking 🔥🍗
